query: Which influence-set inference approach (static analysis, dynamic tracing, hybrid) best balances soundness and cost for our target languages (C/C++) and build rules, and which existing tools can we reuse?

response.query: Which influence-set inference approach (static analysis, dynamic tracing, hybrid) best balances soundness and cost for our target languages (C/C++) and build rules, and which existing tools can we reuse?
response.answer: Hybrid influence-set inference balances soundness and cost for C/C++. Existing tools like Frama-C and Astrée can be reused. Focus on static analysis for initial soundness, then dynamic tracing for cost efficiency.
